[[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] '''Payne''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed aboard the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|''The Gauntlet'']]. During the [[Battle of the Gauntlet]] he engaged [[Havoc Squad]] in combat, but was defeated and killed.
